toegepas.voor: bestaan albei uit beentjies en kraakbeen
toegepas.na: bestaan albei uit been en kraakbeen
toegepas.rede_vinder: Matches the block's own earlier 'van been of kraakbeen'; a whole skeleton is made of bone, not only small bones.
toegepas.fout: 'beentjies en kraakbeen' pairs a countable diminutive (small bones) with a material noun, and a whole skeleton, skull included, is not only small bones; the block itself says 'van been of kraakbeen' earlier.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Restores the parallel with the block's own 'van been of kraakbeen' and is more exact, with the same claim, same subjects and no protected wording touched.
